paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for three different consistency models. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis represents BLEU with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 32, with tick labels at intervals of 2. There are three lines displayed: a purple dashed line with circular markers representing Consistency-CE, beginning at (1, 19.5) and ending at (8, 29.5); a green solid line with square markers representing Consistency-Uni, beginning at (1, 25.3) and ending at (8, 31.5); and a red dashed line with triangular markers representing Consistency-Bi, beginning at (1, 25.4) and ending at (8, 32).
